entities.summary: Sokoto Caliphate, a political institution in Nigeria during Atlantic Slave Trade and Nigeria (1804–1903). Grew from Sokoto Caliphate Founded 1809 and Usman Dan Fodio Jihad 1804. Led to the emergence of Sokoto Caliphate (Fulani Jihad).
